ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low internal contrast across the fluke surface, dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels. High global contrast occurs only at the boundary between the fluke edge and the high-intensity (white) background water.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Nearly uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. No high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs or mottling are detected on the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 35-40 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the visible vertical height of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by small peaks and valleys (5-12 pixel amplitudes) with more pronounced irregularities on the distal third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple faint, circular grey ring-like pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle scarring) are visible in the mid-surface region of both lobes; at least 5 distinct clusters on the left lobe and 4 on the right.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several faint, near-horizontal linear pixel disruptions located in the mid-region of the right lobe, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregularity and potential minor tissue loss on the far-left distal tip and along the outer margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of dark pigmentation covering approximately 98% of the visible surface area.
